text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahahahaaa! Destroy it! Kick it wide open! Break through the puny superego that constrains me!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
For that one intense, breathtaking moment,
I wouldn't care if a hundred fences broke!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh! My shoe...!
A mischievous wind god indeed.
To carry it off into a puddle, of all places...
Tanino Gimlet picked up her soaking-wet shoe and returned to the dorm with a listless look on her face...
